description: Adaptive Learning system — three panels within the Meta-Optimizer page that display playbook lessons, curated examples, template performance, GEPA prompt evolution history, and learning trend charts. The system learns from every workflow run and injects lessons into future generation prompts.

groups.name: Tab Navigation
groups.description: The three adaptive learning tabs in the Meta-Optimizer page tab bar: Adaptive Learning, Playbook, and Prompt Evolution.

assertions.description: An 'Adaptive Learning' tab button is present in the Meta-Optimizer tab bar.
A 'Playbook' tab button is present in the Meta-Optimizer tab bar.
A 'Prompt Evolution' tab button is present in the Meta-Optimizer tab bar.
Clicking each adaptive learning tab switches the content area to the corresponding panel. The active tab has a zinc-800 background and zinc-100 text; inactive tabs have zinc-400 text.

groups.name: Learning Dashboard — Stat Cards
groups.description: The Adaptive Learning tab displays four stat cards at the top showing aggregate counts from the adaptive learning system.

assertions.description: A stat card labeled 'Playbook Lessons' displays the total count with detail showing 'N active, M staged'.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected

assertions.description: A stat card labeled 'Curated Examples' displays the total few-shot library count with detail 'Few-shot library'.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected

assertions.description: A stat card labeled 'Templates Tracked' displays the count of templates with performance data.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected

assertions.description: A stat card labeled 'GEPA Optimizations' displays the total GEPA run count with avg helpfulness detail.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected

assertions.description: The four stat cards are arranged in a 4-column grid with 12px gap. Each card has #111827 background, 8px border-radius, 16px padding, and a #1f2937 border.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected

groups.name: Learning Dashboard — Trend Charts
groups.description: SVG-based charts showing lesson growth, domain distribution, and helpfulness trends over the last 30 days.

assertions.description: A 'Lesson Growth' chart is rendered as an SVG bar chart. Bars are colored by severity (critical=#ef4444, high=#f97316, medium=#f59e0b, low=#3b82f6, info=#6b7280). Shows lessons added per day over the last 30 days. If no data, shows empty chart area.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected and data loaded

assertions.description: A 'Domain Distribution' chart shows horizontal bars for each verification domain (api, ui, database, security, compilation, general) with counts. Bars are colored from the DOMAIN_COLORS palette.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected and data loaded

assertions.description: A 'Helpfulness Trend' chart shows an SVG line chart with area fill displaying avg_helpfulness (0.0-1.0) over time. Line color is #3b82f6 with 0.15 opacity fill. Includes grid lines and dot markers.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected and data loaded

groups.name: Learning Dashboard — Template Performance Table
groups.description: Table showing verification template performance data with success/failure counts, confidence, and quality scores.

assertions.description: A 'Template Performance' heading is visible above the template table.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected and templates exist

assertions.description: The template table has columns: Template, Source, Success, Failure, Confidence, Avg Quality. Source shows a colored badge (manual=#60a5fa, extracted=#34d399, promoted=#fbbf24, demoted=#f87171, retired=#6b7280).
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected and templates exist

assertions.description: Confidence values > 70% are displayed in green (#22c55e), 40-70% in yellow (#f59e0b), and < 40% in red (#ef4444).
assertions.precondition: Template table has rows with varying confidence

groups.name: Learning Dashboard — Error & Empty States
groups.description: Error handling and empty states for the Learning Dashboard.

assertions.description: While data is loading, the dashboard shows 'Loading dashboard...' in #9ca3af text.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab selected and data is being fetched

assertions.description: When the API call fails, the dashboard shows an informative message about tables not existing yet and a blue 'Retry' button. Clicking Retry re-fetches the data. The component does NOT show perpetual 'Loading...' after an error.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab selected and API call has failed

groups.name: Playbook Panel — Header & Filters
groups.description: The Playbook tab header with title, domain filter, status filter, and refresh button.

assertions.description: The Playbook panel shows 'Playbook Lessons' as a heading.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab is selected

assertions.description: A domain filter dropdown with options: All Domains, Compilation, API, UI, Database, Security, General. Background #1f2937, border #374151, text #e5e7eb.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab is selected

assertions.description: A status filter dropdown with options: All Status, Active, Staged, Retired. Defaults to 'Active'.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab is selected

assertions.description: A blue 'Refresh' button (#3b82f6 background, white text) reloads the playbook entries when clicked.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab is selected

groups.name: Playbook Panel — Severity Groups
groups.description: Lessons are organized into three severity groups: Critical (red), Important (yellow), Minor (gray). Each group has an uppercase header with count.

assertions.description: If critical lessons exist, a 'CRITICAL (N)' header in #ef4444 text is shown, followed by the critical lesson rows.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected and critical entries exist

assertions.description: If important lessons exist, an 'IMPORTANT (N)' header in #f59e0b text is shown, followed by the important lesson rows.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected and important entries exist

assertions.description: When no entries match the filters, the message 'No playbook entries found. Lessons are automatically extracted from workflow runs.' is displayed in #9ca3af text.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected and no entries match filters

groups.name: Playbook Panel — Lesson Row Content
groups.description: Each lesson row displays a DO/DON'T prefix, lesson text, category label, helpfulness ratio, and action buttons.

assertions.description: Each lesson shows 'DO' (green #22c55e) or 'DON'T' (red #ef4444) prefix based on the positive field. The prefix is bold with min-width 50px.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected and entries are visible

assertions.description: Each lesson shows a category label from: Step Construction, Selector Choice, Error Handling, Tool Usage, Domain Knowledge, Anti-Pattern. Displayed in #6b7280 at 11px font.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected and entries are visible

assertions.description: Each lesson shows its helpfulness ratio as a percentage. Ratios > 50% are green (#22c55e), otherwise #9ca3af. Shows 'n/a' when times_applied is 0.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected and entries are visible

groups.name: Playbook Panel — Lesson Actions
groups.description: Interactive controls for managing playbook entries: activate, retire, delete with confirmation.

assertions.description: Staged entries show an 'Activate' button. Clicking it calls update_playbook_entry_status with new_status='active', then refreshes the list.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected, status filter set to 'staged', at least one staged entry

assertions.description: Active entries show a 'Retire' button. Clicking it calls update_playbook_entry_status with new_status='retired', then refreshes the list.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected and active entries are visible

assertions.description: Each lesson has a 'Delete' button. First click changes to 'Confirm?' with red background. Clicking 'Confirm?' deletes the entry. If not confirmed within 3 seconds, reverts to 'Delete'.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected and entries are visible

groups.name: Playbook Panel — Expanded Detail View
groups.description: Clicking a lesson row expands it to show metadata and source run context.

assertions.description: Clicking a lesson row toggles the detail panel open/closed. Only one lesson can be expanded at a time.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected and entries are visible

assertions.description: The expanded detail panel shows: Status badge, Category, Domain (or 'all'), Applied count, Helped count, and Created date.
assertions.precondition: A lesson row is expanded

assertions.description: When a lesson has a source run, the detail panel shows 'Source Run' section with run_id, status, duration, iterations, strategy, and architecture. If no source run is found, this section is omitted.
assertions.precondition: A lesson row is expanded and source run data is available

groups.name: Prompt Evolution Panel — Header & Filter
groups.description: The Prompt Evolution tab header with title, domain filter, and refresh button.

assertions.description: The panel shows 'Prompt Evolution (GEPA)' as its heading.
assertions.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab is selected

assertions.description: A domain filter dropdown allows filtering GEPA runs by domain. Clicking a domain summary card also sets the filter to that domain.
assertions.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab is selected

assertions.description: When no GEPA runs exist, shows 'No GEPA optimization runs yet. Runs are triggered automatically after enough workflow executions.' in #9ca3af text.
assertions.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and no GEPA runs exist

groups.name: Prompt Evolution Panel — Domain Summary Cards
groups.description: Summary cards showing per-domain GEPA optimization stats with total improvement.

assertions.description: Each domain card shows: domain name (capitalized, bold), run count and improvement count, and total cumulative improvement as a percentage with green (#22c55e) color when positive.
assertions.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and GEPA runs exist

assertions.description: Clicking a domain card filters the run table to that domain. The active card gets a blue (#3b82f6) border highlight. Clicking again resets to 'all' domains.
assertions.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and GEPA runs exist

groups.name: Prompt Evolution Panel — Run History Table
groups.description: Table of GEPA optimization runs with columns for date, domain, old score, new score, improvement, and status.

assertions.description: The run history table has columns: Date, Domain, Old Score, New Score, Improvement, Status.
assertions.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and GEPA runs exist

assertions.description: Positive improvements are shown in green (#22c55e) with a '+' prefix. Negative improvements are shown in red (#ef4444).
assertions.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and GEPA runs with results exist

assertions.description: Status badges are colored: completed=#34d399 on #1e3a2f, pending=#60a5fa on #1e3a5f, failed=#f87171 on #3b1e1e, canary=#fbbf24 on #3b2f1e.
assertions.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and GEPA runs exist

groups.name: Prompt Evolution Panel — Before/After Prompt Diff
groups.description: Expanded GEPA run detail showing the old and new generation instructions side-by-side with score delta.

assertions.description: Clicking a run row in the table expands a detail panel below it. Clicking again collapses it. Only one run can be expanded at a time.
assertions.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and GEPA runs exist

assertions.description: The expanded detail shows two bordered boxes: 'Before' with a red-tinted header containing the old_instructions, and 'After' with a green-tinted header containing the new_instructions. If new_instructions is null, the After box shows 'No improved instructions generated'.
assertions.precondition: A GEPA run row is expanded

assertions.description: The detail panel shows a prominent score delta indicator with the old score, new score, and improvement percentage. Positive deltas show a green arrow/indicator.
assertions.precondition: A GEPA run row is expanded and scores are available

groups.name: Auto-Refresh Behavior
groups.description: All three adaptive learning panels auto-refresh on learning-update events and periodic timers.

assertions.description: When a 'learning-update' Tauri event is emitted (after a workflow run completes), all three panels re-fetch their data without requiring a manual click.
The Playbook panel refreshes every 30 seconds via setInterval.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab is selected

assertions.description: The Learning Dashboard and Prompt Evolution panels refresh every 60 seconds via setInterval.
assertions.precondition: Adaptive Learning or Prompt Evolution tab is selected

groups.name: Visual Design — Colors & Typography
groups.description: Consistent dark theme design across all adaptive learning panels.

assertions.description: All panels use #111827 for card backgrounds and #1f2937 for borders, consistent with the runner's dark theme.
Primary text is #e5e7eb. Secondary/muted text is #9ca3af. Tertiary/label text is #6b7280. All text is legible against dark backgrounds.
Primary action buttons use #3b82f6 background with white text. Danger/delete buttons use red tones. All buttons have 4px border-radius and 'pointer' cursor.

groups.name: Learning Loop — Data Correctness
groups.description: Semantic assertions verifying that the adaptive learning system produces correct, consistent data across its three panels.

assertions.description: The 'Playbook Lessons' count on the Adaptive Learning dashboard should match the total number of entries visible in the Playbook tab (accounting for filters). The 'N active, M staged' detail should match the counts when filtering by those statuses.
assertions.precondition: Both Adaptive Learning and Playbook tabs have loaded data

assertions.description: The sum of entries across Critical, Important, and Minor severity groups should equal the total entry count for the current filter. No entries should be missing or duplicated across groups.
assertions.precondition: Playbook tab selected and entries exist

assertions.description: All helpfulness ratios displayed in the Playbook should be between 0% and 100%. The avg_lesson_helpfulness on the dashboard should be consistent with individual entry ratios.
assertions.precondition: Playbook and Dashboard have loaded data with applied entries

assertions.description: For each GEPA run, the improvement value should equal new_score - old_score. The domain summary card's total improvement should equal the sum of positive improvements for that domain's completed runs.
assertions.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and GEPA runs with results exist
